description: Publishes privacy-minimized, source-defined active District of Columbia Basic Business License customer/premise groups while preserving activity rows and official geocodes.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact DCGIS FEEDS/DCRA Basic Business License FeatureServer layer and query paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, ArcGIS errors, selected-schema drift, duplicate GlobalID, refresh drift, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Acquire the exact Active/Business License query in deterministic OBJECTID order and hash the complete selected-field snapshot before grouped normalization. Recheck metadata and count before publication; publish the manifest and current pointer last and atomically.
idempotency: The uniform DATAREFRESHEDON value, exact source filter, selected-field schema fingerprint, and selected-source SHA-256 identify a source release. Customer Number identifies one provisional license organization/site group regardless of activity-row count.
cancellation: Abort network and local grouping cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
